_comment: No site recipe: smart-trust-phw takes the smart-hiv shape (owner, 2026-10-14) — index.config.json names smart-base as the site's landing, and the mounted layers supply the steps from the cached AST. Only the workspaces remain.
name: @litlfred/smart-trust-phw-site
_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers, as workspaces, as folio-assistant's root package.json lists them: they import each other by package name (@litlfred/cat-harness, ...), and nothing publishes those packages, so a bare `bun install` in a mount fails with a 404. Owner, 2026-10-14: "Repo declares workspaces". The mounts are laid down from index.lock.json and gitignored; smart-base and bootstrap declare no dependencies, so they are not listed; smart-base's scripts still import packages (zod, @litlfred/bootstrap-tools), which reach it through the ONE root node_modules that bunfig.toml's hoisted linker lays out, as in folio-assistant.
_overrides_comment: 2026-10-15: expo is reached only through fhir-harness's fhirclient -> isomorphic-webcrypto -> optional expo-random, whose peer is expo. expo's latest release asks for @expo/cli ^58.1.9, which npm does not have (58.1.8 is the newest), so an install with no lockfile, as stage-local runs it, fails to resolve. Pinned to 57.0.29, the version folio-assistant's bun.lock resolves. Drop the pin once @expo/cli 58.1.9 is published.
